description: Manufacturer's properties that describe the rudimentary data of the inlet connection.

CriticalBackingPressure.description: Maximum backing pressure for which the conditions are defined in the instruction manual or in a specific standard for the particular vacuum pump.
CriticalBackingPressure.title: CriticalBackingPressure

InletAreaOfThePump.description: Free cross-sectional area of the entry opening in the inlet connection of the pump.
InletAreaOfThePump.title: InletAreaOfThePump

MaximumAllowableInletPressure.description: Highest value of inlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
MaximumAllowableInletPressure.title: MaximumAllowableInletPressure

MaximumTolerableWaterVaporInletPressure.description: The highest water vapor inlet pressure at which a gas ballast pump, under normal ambient conditions, can pump and exhaust pure water vapor in continuous Operation.
MaximumTolerableWaterVaporInletPressure.title: MaximumTolerableWaterVaporInletPressure

MaximumWorkingPressure.description: instantaneous inlet pressure with adequate margin above the minimum liquid vapor pressure expected.
MaximumWorkingPressure.title: MaximumWorkingPressure

MinimumAllowableInletPressure.description: Lowest value of inlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
MinimumAllowableInletPressure.title: MinimumAllowableInletPressure

NetPositiveInletPressureRequired.description: Total inlet pressure required to ensure there is enough margin to maintain the minimum.
NetPositiveInletPressureRequired.title: NetPositiveInletPressureRequired

NominalPressure.description: Alphanumeric parameter for reference purposes, referring to a combination of mechanical and dimensional properties of a component of a piping system. It comprises the letters PN followed by a dimensionless number.
NominalPressure.title: NominalPressure

WaterVaporCapacity.description: Mass of water which can be conveyed by the pump without condensation per time.
WaterVaporCapacity.title: WaterVaporCapacity
